summary: A chapter-for-chapter Vita3K and EmuCoreV comparison that shows each app's setup, interface and settings before a shared gameplay section, making workflow differences visible without proving a universal performance winner.

blocks.text: PRO WARRIORS gives both emulator paths their own preparation sequence instead of comparing isolated clips. Vita3K receives an introduction, setup, interface tour, content import and settings explanation from 00:30 to 03:47; EmuCoreV then receives its own setup, firmware, import and settings chapters through 07:24. Gameplay and performance are compared only after those workflows have been shown. That order helps viewers distinguish usability differences from the later game footage and see which prompts or configuration stages belong to each application.

Hardware model, GPU driver, tested games, renderer values and frame-time collection method are absent from the metadata. Its final verdict is therefore the creator's judgment about the demonstrated run, not a device-independent ranking. A fair performance comparison must use the same phone, game revision, scene, resolution and shader-cache state in both apps. The video's strongest evidence is structural: it places equivalent setup stages side by side and reserves a separate chapter for gameplay.
